runtime_storage_and_reset.external_payload_buffers: HIDDEN input, EMBEDDING, IO, AUX, STATE0, STATE1, OBSERVED are external AXI BOs; ap_rst_n does not clear their payload bytes. Static mapping and runtime access ranges require later RTL measurement.
runtime_storage_and_reset.interpretation: Generated top has power-on initial values for selected persistent scalars and readmemh for 16 runtime-related RAMs. Inspected hardware-reset branches reset FSM/start control; no top runtime scalar is assigned there and the readmemh RAM modules have no if(reset) branch. Cold FPGA initialization is distinct from ap_rst_n reset; warm hardware reset behavior is unproven.
